Ancient Rite: Arcane Light

Char­ac­ter

Flins

Talent Type

Elemental Skill

Category

Combat
Cool­down

  • Info
  • Details
Flins summons forth the ancient power concealed within his lamp and switches to his Manifest Flame form. This form has the following characteristics:
  • Flins's Normal and Charged Attacks deal Electro DMG that cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, and he is unable to perform Plunging Attacks.
  • His interruption resistance is increased.
  • His Elemental Skill Ancient Rite: Arcane Light is replaced with the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm.

Northland Spearstorm
Flins summons a flurry of spears in front, dealing AoE Electro DMG and causing his Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night to be replaced with the special Elemental Burst Thunderous SymphonyThunderous SymphonyConsume less Elemental Energy to unleash a special Elemental Burst. Flins deals a single instance of AoE Electro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal 1 additional instance of AoE Electro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. for the next 6s.
The base CD of Northland Spearstorm is 6s and will not be affected by other effects.

"We shall part the snow-curtain of the sky, and blast the winter winds across the wasteland."

Ancient Rite: Arcane Light is Flins's Elemental Skill.

Gameplay Notes[]

  • When a converted Normal Attack hits at least one enemy, it generates 1 Elemental Particle.
    • This particle generation has a cooldown of 2 seconds.
  • This skill's activation produces a damageless 0U Electro attack around Flins.
Constellation Effects
  • Constellation Level 5, Exile's Shadow: Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.
Northland Spearstorm
